h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panvel

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panvel

items.pText: Panvel is about 50 km from our factory in Vasai, which makes it one of the closest places we supply. The area has grown fast into large townships and gated complexes, many of them built in phases with several small play pockets spread across the layout instead of one central playground.

FunPlay Systems has made outdoor playground equipment since 2002 and has installed a playground for Raymond in Thane, not far from here. For a township with more than one play area, the planning matters as much as the equipment. Share the master plan or the amenity drawing, the size of each pocket and the number of homes in each phase. We will suggest equipment for each pocket and send layout drawings with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Several play pockets in one township

c: Give each pocket a different job. One can be a toddler area with
and a short slide, near the buildings with young families. Another can hold a larger
for older children, further from the windows. A third can take swings and a merry-go-round.

This spreads children across the township and gives them a reason to visit more than one area. Use one colour family across all pockets so the township looks consistent. The Konkan monsoon is heavy, so each pocket needs drainage. See our work for

facts.value: About 48 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: How close is your factory to Panvel?
items.a: Our factory is in Vasai, about 50 km away. Equipment travels by road and our installation team sets it up at your site.

items.q: Can you plan play areas for a phased township?
items.a: Yes. Send us the master plan or amenity drawing, and we will suggest equipment for each play pocket and phase, with a layout drawing for each.

items.q: What should a builder in Panvel send for a quote?
items.a: The amenity drawing, the size of each play area, the expected age groups and photos of the site if it is ready. We then prepare layouts and a quote.
